title: telegram.message.propose input
description: Propose sending a text message to a chat the caller may propose on. Creates an intent: a policy or a human decides, the executor sends. Returns at once (EFF-29). markup: plain (default) or markdown (bold, italic, code, links). Extra fields give no authority and are ignored (EX-02).

business_task_id.description: the caller's task (Signals: action_candidate_id); recorded on the intent, not part of the approved args
